items.text: Hey Fellow Primates! 🐒
We're running like this monkey to try and fix any issues you encounter in the game.
Thank you for the reports, and please keep 'em coming. We'll do our best!
Fixed Achievement "Monkey-Sitter" bug that didn't allow some players to get it after rescuing all baby monkeys (you'll get it next time you rescue a Baby Monkey, once you've collected them all!).
Fixed a minor localization issue for the Portuguese language.
Fixed "Missile" skill description not showing under specific circumstances
Fixed graphical issue with particles in the Lava Monster boss fight.
We hope you're having a good time in the jungle!
In case you were wondering about what's changed in detail since last time, here are the notes for you:
With a powerful new boss, new enemies and hazards.
Find the door at the end of the Volcanic Caves or the Abandoned Tunnels (after beating the Corrupted Jungle at least once). Beware of the Robot Monkeys!!
CYBORG MONKEY: Powered by electricity! Batteries not included.
SLIPPERY FISH: Eww, it's so oily! Great in watery areas.
Ann Flores Greatsword: Enormous high-tech blade that belongs to a skilled young woman from the future.
Ann Flores Bladestaff: Light high-tech blades that belong to a skilled young woman from the future. They offer quick-attacks and high mobility.
Repulsor Gauntlet: Build up energy and release a potent blast.
Homing Missile: Advanced technology projectile. Chases down enemies, inflicting damage in a big area.
Summon Yarara: A snake that stays on your back and bites close enemies.
Summon Spearman: A loyal masked dude ally who throws spears at enemies.
Magician Cape: Produce magic pigeons when rolling!
Silver Spatula: Increase your Max Health with food!
Crystal Heart: Increase your Max Health! But decrease it every time you get hit
Meteor Ring: Unleash meteors on attack!
Piñata: Get random items upon pickup!
Ground Pound will now deal more damage if you use it from higher up!
When assigning an Equipment Modifier (such as fire, ice, electric...) to an already modified equipment, the previous Modifier will now drop as loot, so you don't lose it!
Blacksmith: When an item breaks, if it has any Modifier on it, the modifier will now drop as loot.
Monkey Merchant: Added Shop ReRolls permanent upgrade.
Food items will now have an indicator on the Minimap.
Changed rarity of Blasting Cloak Relic (from Rare to Normal)
Buffed most Amulet Upgrade Effects
Boss Doors will have an indicator showing boss type (activates after you defeat that boss at least once)
Endless Mode: Added Tank Rooms to the rotation
Endless Mode: Added Neon Jungle Rooms
Added Special Rooms (tank, speed, tower) to all areas
Added more combat room layouts
Equipment Modifier image was persisting when moving a Skill to an empty slot.
Implemented a fix for very rare cases where the exit door would be inaccessible
Added French and German languages.
Collect all baby monkeys: Monkey-Sitter
Reach Neon Jungle for the first time: Cyber Monkey
Beat the final boss at the Neon Jungle: Monkeys hate AI
Rescue all the monkey fairies in a room: Monkey Fairies
Exit a room with 3 or more keys in your pocket: Monkey Locksmith
The Dunjungle Team

releases.displayName: Critical Mac Save Fix, Gameplay Tweaks & Relic Rebalance!

items.text: Hey Fellow Primates!

First and foremost – we've urgently addressed the save file issue on Mac. Don't worry, your progress was never deleted! After updating to v0.91, affected players will be able to recover their saves. This update also includes important gameplay adjustments and relic balancing...
Dunjungle Early Access v0.91 - Patch Notes
Fixed critical issue for Mac players that made their save file go missing (related to Unity changing it's default save data path): ##

Player movement: Changes in the Sprint action. Now if you quickly turn around while sprinting, you will keep running on all fours. Also, attacking won't end your sprinting if you keep pressing the directional button.
Baby Monkey Coin now has a UI indicator to let you know if you have Revives left.
When you have an active Energy Coat, your Health Bar turns blue to indicate this.
Updated Joystick button icons for better readability
Added gamepad support for Stadia Controller
Switch Pro Controller: Fixed Submit and Cancel buttons (they were inverted): ##
Idols: Buffed Stat gain (from 10% to 15%)
Relics that auto-cast spell on melee changed to auto-cast on main weapon attack (so now it works with non-melee main weapons): As always, stay tuned!: The Dunjungle Team

releases.displayName: Major Update is on the Way 🐒

items.text: Hello, Fellow Primates!

It’s been over four months since Dunjungle entered Early Access. During this time, we’ve introduced the [Endless Mode] gameplay, added a new biome—the [Sunken Shrine]—and rolled out over a dozen updates featuring dozens of weapons, skills, and skins. Thank you so much for your incredible support and for joining us on this journey.

You may have noticed it’s been over a month since our last update. Rest assured, we haven’t slowed down. Instead, we’ve been dedicating time to prepare a brand-new biome—and we’re excited to share a sneak peek with you today!
This major update will go live around next Thursday, March 13th.

notes.title: The update will feature a complete new biome packed with

items.text: New Biome!: The corrupting force has seeped underground, awakening an eroded subterranean kingdom.
New Enemies and Threats: The dwellers of the depths have twisted into monsters, fiercely defending their queen.
Two Brand New Bosses: Face a manic Corrupted Ant Queen and a greedy, earth-shaking Miner driven by ambition.
New Baby Monke: Monkeys in each region boast unique traits, but one thing unites them all—they’re absolutely adorable ♥
Additionally, Endless Mode will be updated to include the new area, inviting all ape guardians to test their limits against the latest challenges!

That’s a sneak peek at the exciting content arriving in the next big update 🐒. This new area will feature stunning art, immersive sound design, and rigorous testing to ensure a polished experience. We’re working hard to deliver something amazing—stay tuned and stay hyped!

releases.displayName: The First Major Update is on the Way 🐒

items.text: Hello, Fellow Primates!

Since the Early Access launch of Dunjungle, we’ve been rolling out weekly updates, introducing a number of classes, weapons, and relics to aid in the fight to defend the forest. Recently, we even added an Endless Mode to challenge the unrelenting forces of corruption.
Your incredible support and feedback have inspired us, and from this week, we’re pausing our regular update schedule to focus on preparing a brand-new biome for the next major update.
New Biome!: The corrupting force has reached a mystical underwater world, where whispers of sunken treasures lure adventurers.
New Enemies and Threats: Monsters lurk beneath the water’s surface, and ancient ruins are riddled with natural traps.
Two Brand New Bosses: "Rumor has it there’s a frog in the forest claiming to be king. Ruling over a pond doesn’t make one a monarch…"
New Baby Monke: Monkeys in each region boast unique traits, but one thing unites them all—they’re absolutely adorable ♥
Additionally, Endless Mode will be updated to include the new area, inviting all ape guardians to test their limits against the latest challenges!

That’s a sneak peek at the exciting content arriving in the next big update 🐒. This new area will feature stunning art, immersive sound design, and rigorous testing to ensure a polished experience. We’re working hard to deliver something amazing—stay tuned and stay hyped!
Bug Fixed: Dungeon generator - In rare occasions, the game offered you an unintended choice of doors that could result in a black screen if the player went through.

Thank you for your support! If you have any questions, please feel free to reach out to us by any means you can find!
The Dunjungle Team,

We'll continue to do our best to polish Dunjungle in order to present it to you in its best form in the future full release. Thanks again for your continued support!
The Dunjungle Team

releases.displayName: [Big Update] New Demo, and Publisher announcement!

items.text: Hey everyone!
I'm super thrilled to announce that Astrolabe Games will be publishing Dunjungle!
This relationship will allow me to focus 100% on the development of the game, helping make Dunjungle the best that it can be.
Having said that, I'm also excited to share a MAJOR update in the demo! Here you can find a list of what's new since the last update:
LOCALIZATION - More languages are available! English, Spanish, Chinese (simplified and traditional), and Japanese.
WEAPON SPECIAL ATTACKS - ALL primary weapons received were updated! Hold the attack button to execute each weapon Special Attack.
EQUIPMENT RARITY SYSTEM - Now you can find different versions of each Weapon and Skill! Common, Rare, Epic, and Legendary. Increasing the quality and adding stat bonuses.
PERMANENT PROGRESSION - Putting the 'T' in 'RogueliTe', Dunjungle now offers permanent upgrades that you can progressively unlock to increase your power for your following incursions.
FAMILIARS - You can now find and rescue BABY MONKEYS that will follow you around and help you for the rest of the run.
NEW EQUIPMENT - Loads of new Relics with cool effects to enhance your strategies, and new weapons to use.
ENEMIES - New Rooms and new enemies to fight.
INPUT SYSTEM - You can now customize your inputs. Keyboard and Gamepad.
There's also a Survey link on the main menu. Feel free to complete it for general feedback on the game, or as always, you can also contact me or post in the Community hub.
That's all for today.
Hope you enjoy the new content!
